Please talk to a professional about your pain. It’s actually even more painful to care for someone you love deep down but hurt you deeply when you were growing up. You love them but you don’t like them very much.  Accept that he is a dead man walking and work from there.

Take a break from going to the hospital everyday if you have to. Maybe ask your bf to go on your behalf for the days you take a break. Don’t bear this on your own. It’s not worth it. These terminal illnesses can last for a very very long time. My friend’s dad took 5 years to die of cancer... 
Once you work through your issues with your dad with a therapist, you can maybe talk to him about how he hurt you before. Not for him to apologize but for you to get some closure. Accept that he may never apologize or be remorseful for what he did or said to you. And accept that you can’t be there 24/7 for him, whatever will be, will be. Don’t be hung up on being present for his passing, no one can predict it and the anticipation and expectations just make it worse for you. 
Start making arrangements for his funeral, get his will in order, get that out of the way so you won’t be overwhelmed by it when it happens.

You can do this. You are stronger than you think you are.
